answer_1.quote: This paper introduces a novel task, Multi-Question Generation (MQG)... we propose the MQG-KR approach, combining MQG with Keypoint Retriever (KR).
datasets: Earnings conference call transcription dataset (995 calls from 18 companies)

answer_2.quote: We employ the ROUGE-L score for evaluating the generated results. Additionally, ... we propose two additional evaluation metrics, namely ROUGE-AMG and ROUGE-AMR, to assess the results from different perspectives.
